process.pageTagline: From a tender leaf on the mountain to a perfect cup of tea, every step carries the craftsman's devotion and centuries of tradition
process.otherStylesDesc: The process above uses Taiwan oolong as the example. Different tea types follow different methods — green tea skips oxidation entirely, black tea undergoes full oxidation, and white tea is only withered without rolling. Each technique is the finest expression of that tea's character.

pick.name: Harvesting
pick.desc: At six in the morning, tea pickers climb the mountain with their tools. The best leaves are harvested at just the right maturity to bring out the fullest aroma and flavor. Hand-picking ensures only the most tender two leaves and a bud are selected.
pick.detail: Harvest seasons: Spring (April), Summer (June), Autumn (September), Winter (November)

witherSun.name: Sun Withering
witherSun.desc: Freshly picked leaves are spread on clean cloth and exposed to sunlight for sun withering. This step removes some moisture, softens the cell structure, prepares the leaves for indoor withering, and begins to awaken the initial aromatic compounds.
witherSun.detail: Duration: 1–2 hours, adjusted according to sunlight and temperature

witherIndoor.name: Indoor Withering
witherIndoor.desc: The leaves are moved indoors and spread on well-ventilated withering racks. In a temperature- and humidity-controlled environment, the master periodically turns the leaves to ensure even moisture loss while aromas continue to develop.

shake.name: Tossing
shake.desc: This is one of the most critical steps in oolong production. The master rhythmically tosses the leaves by hand or in a bamboo sieve, causing slight bruising at the leaf edges that triggers enzymatic oxidation and develops the tea's characteristic floral and fruity fragrance.
shake.detail: Frequency: once every 1.5–2.5 hours, repeated 2–4 times

fix.name: Stir Fixation
fix.desc: Once the ideal level of oxidation is reached, the leaves are tossed in a high-temperature iron wok to deactivate the enzymes and halt oxidation. This step also develops a toasted aroma, locks in the fragrance, and removes the raw grassy notes.

roll.name: Cloth Rolling
roll.desc: While still warm from the wok, the leaves are wrapped in cloth and rolled, compressing them into tight balls or twisted strips. This bonds the tea juices to the leaf surface so that when brewed, the leaves unfurl quickly and release their full, rounded flavor.
roll.detail: Repeated rolling 3–6 times, 20–30 minutes per session

roast.name: Roasting
roast.desc: Precision roasting is the tea's final transformation. The master determines the roast level based on the tea's character: light roasting preserves floral notes, medium roasting adds ripe fruit tones, and heavy roasting brings out deep, rich roasted complexity. This step also reduces residual moisture to extend shelf life.
roast.detail: Temperature: 70–120°C, duration: 4–16 hours depending on style

sort.name: Sorting & Packaging
sort.desc: Once the tea is finished, the master hand-sorts each batch to remove old leaves, stems, and any impurities, ensuring consistent quality across every lot. The tea is vacuum-sealed in foil bags to preserve its aroma, so every pack you receive is as fresh as the day it was made.
sort.detail: Every batch comes with a quality certification label

hero.label: Privacy Policy
hero.title: Privacy Policy
hero.tagline:
Wu Jue Tea values your personal data security and privacy.
Please read the following carefully.

s1.title: 1. Purpose of Personal Data Collection
s1.content:
This website (Wu Jue Tea), in accordance with the Personal Data Protection Act, collects necessary personal data when you use our services for the following purposes:

• Order processing and fulfillment: including name, phone number, email, and shipping address, used for order confirmation, shipment arrangement, and order notifications.
• Customer service: handling return/exchange requests, inquiries, and after-sales service.
• Newsletter and marketing communications (with your explicit consent only): occasional notifications about new products and promotional offers.

We will not use your personal data for purposes beyond those stated above without your consent.

s2.title: 2. Scope of Personal Data Usage
s2.content:
Personal data collected by this website is used only within the following scope:

• Providing the products or services you requested.
• Sending order-related notifications (order confirmation, shipping updates).
• Processing your payments (through ECPay payment platform; we do not store your credit card information).
• Complying with legal requirements or requests from judicial/administrative authorities through legal procedures.

We will not sell, rent, or otherwise provide your personal data to any third party, except for logistics providers and payment service providers necessary for order fulfillment, and only to the extent required to complete the order.

s3.title: 3. Personal Data Protection Measures
s3.content:
This website employs appropriate technical and administrative measures to protect your personal data:

• The website uses HTTPS encryption to ensure data security during transmission.
• Order data is stored in a cloud database (Supabase) with security protections and access controls.
• Payment processing is handled through the ECPay payment platform; we do not store any credit card or financial account information.
• Our staff may only access customer personal data when necessary for their duties.

In the event of a personal data breach, we will notify affected individuals in accordance with the law.

s4.title: 4. Cookie Policy
s4.content:
This website uses cookies and similar technologies to improve user experience:

• Essential cookies: necessary for basic website functions such as shopping cart and login status.
• Analytics cookies (if applicable): to understand how visitors use the website and help improve content and features.

You may refuse or delete cookies through your browser settings, but this may affect the normal operation of certain website features.

s5.title: 5. Your Rights
s5.content:
Under Article 3 of the Personal Data Protection Act, you have the following rights regarding your personal data held by this website:

• Right to inquire or request access: You may inquire about the personal data we hold about you at any time.
• Right to request copies: You may request copies of your personal data.
• Right to supplement or correct: You may request corrections if your personal data is inaccurate or incomplete.
• Right to request cessation: You may request that we stop collecting, processing, or using your personal data.
• Right to request deletion: You may request that we delete your personal data.

To exercise these rights, please contact us by phone (0972-619-391) or email (qdbzdt2846@gmail.com). We will respond within 15 business days.

If exercising these rights incurs necessary costs, we may charge a reasonable fee. If your request is unreasonable, excessively repetitive, or abusive, we may refuse or charge a reasonable fee in accordance with the law.

s6.title: 6. Data Retention Period
s6.content:
This website retains personal data for the following periods:

• Order-related data: 5 years from order completion (per Consumer Protection Act and tax regulations).
• Customer service records: 2 years from case closure.
• Marketing mailing lists: until you unsubscribe, or when we cease marketing activities.

After the retention period expires, we will destroy or de-identify the data in accordance with the law.

s7.title: 7. Third-Party Links
s7.content: This website may contain links to third-party websites. We are not responsible for the privacy policies or content of those websites. We recommend reviewing their privacy policies before visiting.

s8.title: 8. Privacy Policy Amendments
s8.content:
This website reserves the right to amend this privacy policy at any time. Updated policies will be posted on this page. For significant changes, we will notify you prominently (such as posting on the homepage or sending an email). We recommend reviewing this policy periodically.

This privacy policy was last updated on January 1, 2026.

section1.title: 7-Day Inspection Period
section1.content: Under Article 19 of the Consumer Protection Act, you have a 7-day cooling-off period after receiving your product, during which you may request a return without stating a reason.
section1.noteContent: The inspection period is a "reasonable period for examining the product," not a trial period. Products should remain in new, unopened condition. Please do not open or use the product before requesting a return, as this may affect your return rights.

s1.desc: Within 7 days of receiving your product, call 0972-619-391 or email qdbzdt2846@gmail.com with your order number, return items, and reason.

s2.desc: We will confirm your return eligibility and arrange the return process within 2 business days.

s3.desc: Please return the product with its original packaging, any gifts, and the invoice. Return shipping is paid by the customer; if the product is defective or was shipped incorrectly, we will cover the shipping cost.

s4.desc: After we receive and verify the returned product, we will arrange a refund within 3 business days.

m1.label: Credit Card Payment
m1.desc: Refunds will be returned to the original credit card account. Processing takes approximately 7–14 business days depending on your bank.

m2.label: Cash on Delivery
m2.desc: Refunds will be issued via bank transfer. Please provide your bank details (bank name, branch, account number, account holder). Refunds will be processed within 3 business days after return confirmation.

section4.title: Return Exceptions
section4.intro: Under Article 19, Paragraph 2 of the Consumer Protection Act, the 7-day inspection period does not apply in the following cases:

exceptions.e1: Product has been opened (tea and food products cannot be returned once opened due to hygiene and safety concerns)
exceptions.e2: Product is damaged, soiled, or missing parts due to non-defect-related causes
exceptions.e4: Product has deteriorated or been damaged due to improper use or storage
exceptions.e5: Product has been used or tried

section4.noteContent: Wu Jue Tea products are agricultural food products. To maintain food safety and hygiene, tea products cannot be returned or exchanged once opened. Please evaluate carefully before purchasing. If you notice packaging damage or obvious defects upon delivery, please take photos and contact us within 48 hours. We will arrange a replacement or refund as appropriate.
